title: State of Play Confirmed for 2nd June, 60+ Minutes of Wolverine and PS5 Games
summary:
Sony confirms its big summer showcase.

Sony has today revealed its next State of Play livestream will take place on 2nd June 2026. It's going to be over an hour long, and Marvel's Wolverine will be there alongside "updates, announcements, and gameplay reveals from top studios around the world".

As for Marvel's Wolverine, Sony says Insomniac will have "more from its upcoming third-person action-adventure game showing off Logan’s brutal and relentless combat along with some new details". It's due out on 15th September for PS5.

summary:
A roll of the dice.

A big budget Dungeons & Dragons project that was announced around this time last year has been canned, according to a report from Bloomberg.

title: 'We're Not Standing Still': Returnal Director Forms New Studio to Make Games That Trust You
summary:
Harry Krueger establishes Cosmic Division.

Harry Krueger, director of Returnal and a 14-year Housemarque veteran, has announced the formation of his new team.

Cosmic Division is its name, and it’s already working on its first project: a single player “gameplay-first” experience packing “a story with strong emotional resonance”. It’s planned for PC and consoles, so the chances there's a PS5 version (or PS6 at this point) are high.

The news confirms the rumours swirling around the studio, which were connecting the IP with the RPG team. Further, it also has "a new Kingdom Come adventure" in the works. Pace race.

To be fair, this isn't just a Square Enix problem. Modern gaming in general seriously struggles to tell well-paced stories thanks to the rise of open world busywork and the visual novel-ification of dialogue delivery.
